name: velozity-ops
description: Real-time client project dashboard with RBAC and live activity feed

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:stack: docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
